name: clipa
description: Animated captions, AI video editing and short clips from long videos, right from the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Clipa adds animated captions, AI editing and short clips to your videos, right from the chat.

Attach a short video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, talking-head) and Clipa transcribes it with word-level timing, highlights keywords and applies one of 21 animated caption styles.

Describe the edit you want and Clipa's AI editor assembles the hook, on-screen cards, cuts and music; you refine it by chat and export in Clipa.

Paste a YouTube link and Clipa finds the strongest moments and cuts them into vertical clips with captions.

Works in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
capabilities: Add animated captions to a video
Edit a talking-head video with AI
Turn a YouTube video into short vertical clips
defaultPrompt: Add animated captions to this video
Edit this talking-head video for TikTok: cut the pauses, add a hook and captions
Turn this YouTube video into short clips

positive.description: Captions for an attached video: Clipa receives the attached file, transcribes it and shows the caption card.
positive.prompt: Add captions to this video (attach any short video, up to 3 minutes, with someone speaking)
positive.expected_behavior: A Clipa card appears showing the video being transcribed, then 'captions ready' with a preview of the transcribed text and a button to choose the caption style and export in Clipa.

positive.description: Captions without an attachment: Clipa offers an upload link instead of failing.
positive.prompt: I want to add captions to a video that is on my phone
positive.expected_behavior: A Clipa card appears with a 'Send video' button that opens an upload page; after the upload, captions start automatically and the card updates.

positive.description: AI editing of a talking-head video from a written brief.
positive.prompt: Edit this video for TikTok: cut the pauses, add a hook and captions (attach a short talking-head video)
positive.expected_behavior: A Clipa card appears saying the video is ready for AI editing, with a button that opens the Clipa editor where the AI assembles the edit following the brief.

positive.description: Short clips from a YouTube link (the test account has long-video clips enabled).
positive.prompt: Turn this YouTube video into short clips: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UF8uR6Z6KLc
positive.expected_behavior: A Clipa card shows processing progress; when done it shows a grid of vertical clips ranked best first, each with a button to edit and export in Clipa. Processing takes a few minutes; asking 'are my clips ready?' calls clipa_get_clips and refreshes the card.

positive.description: Checking the status of a captioning job started earlier in the same conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: The Clipa card for the latest video is shown again with its current status (transcribing or ready) and the transcribed text when ready.

negative.description: Plain text translation has nothing to do with video; Clipa should not be called.
negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into English: 'Bom dia, tudo bem?'

negative.description: Downloading a YouTube video is not something Clipa does; Clipa should not be called to download.
negative.prompt: Download this YouTube video for me: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UF8uR6Z6KLc

negative.description: Pricing questions are answered by the model without calling Clipa and without promoting plans or checkout links.
negative.prompt: How much does Clipa Pro cost?

publication.release_notes: First release: animated captions, AI editing and YouTube-to-clips from the chat.
